Editor notes from [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]], 15 October 2026. Short game article so [[Tom Braunlich]], [[Rollie Tesh]], [[Decipher]] and [[Inspirations for Star Wars CCG]] can link the game. SWCCG crossover only.

* Wikipedia's later designer list (Evan Lorentz; 2E Brad Defruiter). Article keeps Braunlich/Tesh for 1994 and [[Bill Martinson]] as later ''Star Trek'' lead from the Darcy Dagobah interview used on [[Design of Star Wars CCG]].
